projects.name: portfolio-generator
projects.description: Builds a project portfolio from public GitHub repositories, with an Astro site, a Codex plugin template, and live username lookup.
highlights: A GitHub account with public repositories

projects.name: crystal-events
projects.description: A Paper plugin for Minecraft Crystal PvP tournaments, with configurable arenas, kits, a gulag, host commands, preflight checks, and reset tools.

projects.name: minecraft-combat-audio-mixer
projects.description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft Java that gives you live, per-group volume control over combat-relevant vanilla sounds. Eight sound groups mapped over 27 vanilla sounds, live 0-150% sliders, previews, presets, and local JSON preset sharing.
highlights: Eight sound groups mapped over 27 explicitly documented vanilla sound events.
Live 0-150% gain sliders per group: 100% is unchanged, 0% mutes, 150% is the ceiling. Master and category muting stay respected.
Individual per-group previews plus an overlapping combat mix preview (two explosions, a totem, food, an anchor charge, a pearl throw).

projects.name: Dev-Ticket-Bot-Sanitize
projects.description: A comprehensive Discord support ticket bot designed for managing dev work customers. Features AI auto-reply, customer management, encrypted notes, pattern analysis, and more.

projects.name: Tierlistrepo-sanitize
projects.description: A Discord bot for managing Minecraft PvP tier lists, testing queues, and player rankings.
highlights: /result — Record a tier test result with role assignment
/close [tier] — Close a test ticket and assign tier (with transcript)

projects.name: Cat-Tiers-Tier-Tagger
projects.description: A Fabric mod that displays player combat tiers and gamemode icons on nametags in Minecraft. Fully open source.
highlights: Shows tier labels (HT1–LT5) with color coding on player nametags
Displays gamemode icons (Crystal, Sword, Axe, Mace, UHC, NethPot, DiaPot, Spear, SMP, DiamondSMP, Speed)
Auto-fetches data from database every 60 seconds
